description.narrative: Development and Promotion of Climate Finance Mechanisms for a Decarbonized Economy in the Department of El Paraíso, Honduras for agroforestry and to promote food security through the installation of family micro-systems of aquaponics / hydroponics for food production. The FUNDER programme is part of the EU-TEI and the programme will assure expanded coverage using Ireland’s resources to benefit 950 additional producers of coffee, cocoa, basic grains, African bee honey and melipona high quality honey, vegetables, aromatic species, and local fruits. The producers are affiliated to 25 agroforestry organisations that bring the total number of organisations covered by the TEI to 77. With funding from Ireland this programme is delivered in two new municipalities that are of ecological interest: Guinope and Yuscarán in ecological agriculture and improved micro-watersheds management. With EU funding FUNDER works in three other adjacent municipalities.
